result: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence confirms a 300-Ki Strike Ultimate acquired from PQ161. The dedicated skill page documents the chargeable opening kick, weak-Ki-Blast cancellation aura, guard-breaking fully charged kick, two follow-up kicks and finishing Ki Blast; the in-game description states that the opponent cannot Evasive or Limit Burst during the attack. The repository's Basic-vs-Ultimate-Finish reward conflict remains preserved.
evidence_boundary: No unsupported reward probability, hidden prerequisite, frame data, or version-independent numerical mechanics were inferred.
corrections: Canonical ki_cost corrected from stale 500 to source-backed 300.
